description.en: The 影之刃零 (Phantom Blade Zero) theme for the DSH Web GUI, published as its own index while the plugin is only installable from Git.
description.zh: 「影之刃零」DSH Web GUI 主题的自建索引：插件目前只能从 Git 安装，先用这份索引在「发现」里找到它。

description.en: An ink-and-blood theme for the DSH Web GUI after 影之刃零 (Phantom Blade Zero): 素笺 and 墨夜 palettes, the key art as the conversation canvas, drifting maple leaves, fine rain, and a palette switch above the composer.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web GUI 换成水墨武侠观感：素笺与墨夜两套配色、主视觉作为会话画布、飘落的枫叶、细雨，以及输入框上方的配色切换。
